products.name: Grafeo
products.description: A high-performance, Rust-built embeddable graph database supporting multiple query languages (GQL, Cypher, Gremlin, GraphQL, SPARQL, SQL/PGQ) with vectorized execution and adaptive chunking for fast embedded and server deployments.
products.positioning: Fast, lean, embeddable graph DB with multi-language support and lower memory footprint than traditional in-memory databases

products.name: PuppyGraph
products.description: The first real-time, zero-ETL graph query engine that transforms existing relational data stores (Databricks, Snowflake, ClickHouse, etc.) into a unified graph model without ETL, enabling complex queries in seconds at petabyte scale.
products.positioning: Zero-ETL graph query engine that bypasses traditional graph database costs, latency, and maintenance by querying relational data as graphs

products.name: NebulaGraph
products.description: A distributed, highly scalable graph database supporting hundreds of billions of vertices and edges with millisecond-level query latency, offering open-source and enterprise editions with cloud deployments on Azure and AWS.
products.positioning: Unlimited scalable graph infrastructure for AI systems, fraud detection, real-time analytics, and knowledge graphs at enterprise scale

products.name: ArcadeDB
products.description: An open-source multi-model database combining graph, vector, and time-series capabilities in a single platform with support for Cypher and Gremlin query languages, OLAP analytics engine, and GraphBatch for fast ingestion.
products.positioning: Multi-model database unifying graph, vector, and time-series with open-source OLAP analytics and education through ArcadeDB Academy

products.name: HugeGraph
products.description: An Apache Foundation distributed graph database supporting high-speed bulk imports and millisecond-level queries for hundreds of billions of graph data, with deep integration with big data platforms (Spark, Flink) and LLM capabilities for AI applications.
products.positioning: Apache Foundation graph database with big data platform integration for LLM-powered AI, knowledge graphs, recommendation systems, and fraud detection
products.archetype: Distributed Graph DB for Big Data & AI

products.name: BigQuery Graph
products.description: Google Cloud's native graph analytics engine within BigQuery that unifies SQL and GQL (Graph Query Language) on a single platform, enabling graph analysis alongside relational analytics with integrated visualization and knowledge graph support.
products.positioning: Unified SQL+Graph analytics within Google Cloud BigQuery for dark data activation, knowledge graphs, and connected intelligence with integrated Spanner Graph ecosystem

notes: Phase C extraction complete for emerging graph database competitors (Grafeo, PuppyGraph, NebulaGraph, ArcadeDB, HugeGraph, BigQuery Graph). All six products have been mapped to existing companies (or new company stubs as needed). Feature scoring prioritized the 15-35 most relevant capabilities from the 110-feature taxonomy, focusing on: schema introspection, query building, deployment options, documentation/onboarding, integration capabilities, scaling, performance, and vertical-specific features (e.g., vector for ArcadeDB, Big Data integration for HugeGraph, SQL+Graph for BigQuery). Competitive positioning vs MetroGraph emphasizes the HCI/visualization wedge: MetroGraph uniquely addresses the surface-area bloat and flight-to-chat failure of low-code/agent tools by providing visual node-edge graph orchestration for workflows, while all competitors focus on either pure database/query performance (Grafeo, NebulaGraph) or specific integrations (PuppyGraph zero-ETL, HugeGraph big-data, BigQuery SQL+graph). Source coverage spans T0 official products/pricing through T3 comparisons, with strong evidence depth for mature products (NebulaGraph, ArcadeDB, HugeGraph) and emerging evidence for new entrants (Grafeo, PuppyGraph).
